question: PGL Bucharest: Falcons vs. FaZe
description:
Falcons and FaZe are scheduled to play each other in a semi-final matchup in the 2025 PGL Bucharest Tournament on April 12, 2025, at 7:00 AM ET.

This market will resolve to “Falcons” if Falcons advance against FaZe in the semi-finals of the PGL Bucharest Tournament.

This market will resolve to “FaZe” if FaZe advances against Falcons in the semi-finals of the PGL Bucharest Tournament.

If the match ends in a tie, is canceled, or delayed beyond May 28, 2025, this market will resolve to 50-50.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the PGL (https://www.pglesports.com/cs2/pgl-bucharest-2025/).
